message.content:
Polypropylene plastic sleeves for record jackets are most likely to fall under heading 3923, "Articles for the conveyance or packing of goods, of plastics; stoppers, lids, caps and other closures, of plastics." Within it, 3923.21 covers sacks and bags (including cones) of polymers of ethylene, and 3923.29 covers those of other plastics. Polypropylene is a polymer of propylene, so 3923.29 applies. Its statistical suffix 3923.29.0000 is "Other."

Alternatively, 3926.90 (other articles of plastics) or 3921 could apply. The sleeves are open-ended bags used to protect and store records, so heading 3923 is the better fit. CBP rulings on similar record sleeves and comic book bags have used 3923.29.0000 for polypropylene bags.

Another thought is that the product might be classified in 3923.90 as other packing articles. But the bag form points to 3923.29.

{"hts_code": "3923.29.0000", "reason": "Polypropylene open-ended sleeves/bags used to store and protect record jackets are articles for the conveyance or packing of goods, classified as sacks and bags of plastics other than ethylene polymers under heading 3923."}
